amends: the network architecture and the imitation budget; nothing about the task, the world, the reward or the acceptance criteria
when: after five teacher variants showed 1-3 of 6 legs passing, before the next training run

evidence.teacher_is_no_longer_the_limit: the demonstration passes all five criteria on all six legs (DEMO_JAC_TEACHER.json, DEMO_STEP_TEACHER.json), yet the trained network passed 3/6 with the hand-made raise, 3/6 with the Jacobian raise, 1/6 with a 60-tick raise plus a 90-tick swing and 1/6 with a 90-tick raise plus a 90-tick swing
evidence.passing_set_moves: LM passes with one teacher and fails with the next; RM cannot lift at all with the hand-made direction yet passes with the Jacobian direction. The count stays low while the identity of the passing legs changes, which is the signature of one output map trying to express six different programmes rather than six learned programmes
evidence.determinism: a rerun with the same seed reproduces every number exactly (TRAIN_LOG_singleleg_demo_repro.json equals TRAIN_LOG_singleleg_demo_jac.json), so these differences are caused by the teacher and not by seed noise
evidence.imitation_error: BC_FIT.json: per-leg imitation error 0.153-0.224, worst in the swing phase; the share of the variation the single output map cannot capture per leg is large

architecture_change.old: one shared 42-joint output head: w2 shape (128, 42), b2 shape (42,); the leg prompt had to modulate the same output map
architecture_change.new: six 42-joint output heads selected by the leg prompt: w2 shape (128, 252), b2 shape (252,). The trunk is shared, the heads are independent, and only the selected head receives gradient from a sample
architecture_change.logstd: unchanged, shared across heads (one exploration scale per joint)
architecture_change.declared_limit: this is a replacement-ANN architecture change for a single-leg task. A per-leg head cannot coordinate legs by construction, so it is explicitly NOT a walking architecture; walking will need a shared output path.

imitation_budget.new: settable; this round uses 3600 samples (600 per leg) and 1500 gradient steps
imitation_budget.reason: 600 samples per teacher phase boundary is thin, and the swing phase showed the worst imitation error

verification_of_the_change.analytic_gradient: checked against finite differences on the selected head (the analytic and numeric derivatives agree; an earlier check of mine divided a one-sided difference by two epsilon and appeared to disagree by a factor of two, that was a mistake in the check and not in the code)
verification_of_the_change.unchanged: the acceptance criteria, the derived world, the frozen models, the reward and the 495-dimensional observation

preregistered_outcomes: more passing legs than the 3/6 of the previous round means the limit was the shared output map
the same 3/6 or fewer means the limit is elsewhere and must be looked for in the training signal or the observation, and the report has to say so
no result from this amendment may be described as walking, as connectome capability or as frozen-body acceptance
discipline: all earlier preregistrations and amendments are left byte-identical. The report states that this is the first architecture change of the round and gives the numbers before and after.
